reason: The card should not be used as drafted. It is a proposal draft, and nothing in it is unsafe, but its central recommendation (default {V_pub, exp75} when exp75 displays >= 0.955) sits inside the model noise. It also rests on two claims that fail on inspection. (1) JT is misquoted. The 743929 text (experiments/discussions/digest_20260928T0630Z.md l.14) says: 'Pick final slots on the expected value of the better of the two, not on diversity... A decorrelated hedge that sits several thousandths behind loses expected value to a near-twin of the best.' By that criterion the closest neighbour is exp70g (0.956, 0.001 behind), not exp75 (expected 0.955 at P~0.6, 0.954 at ~0.25). The card chooses exp75 because 'it removes the most suspicious lever', which is exactly the diversity argument JT rejects. 'If you follow JT, then exp75' at a 0.954 display is backwards: at 0.954 exp75 is 0.003 behind, which is JT's losing hedge. PC25-06 in the same round reaches the opposite pair. (2) Cap 6 is called 'most suspicious' on the strength of the in-sample lab (-0.0006; 0 TP / 4 FP / 81 unannotated, and unannotated forks are free). The brief says the lab has been WRONG IN SIGN for division knobs and that public reads decide. Cap 6's +0.002 (UP 127) is our largest single-lever public read. The cap posterior is therefore a prior, and mc25 itself shows that C {exp79a, exp70g} ties or wins in cap-tight worlds. (3) By the author's own numbers the edge is small and depends on the prior: E[dP bronze] ~+0.01, with a crossover at a private CI mean of +0.0001. R25P-4 puts P(CI_priv < 0) at ~0.3, while the posterior in R25P-2 uses ~0.2. At 0.3 the edge is ~0 and B puts CI into BOTH finals, which removes the only hedge against CI failing on the private embryos (CI lab per clip: -0.021 / +0.0125 / 0 / +0.0083). FEASIBILITY gaps: (a) All times are in UTC only, which breaks the user's 10:19Z instruction to quote MSK first with UTC in brackets. (b) There is no branch for exp75 still PENDING or unsubmitted at 12:00Z. (c) There is no partner rule if V_pub becomes an E10 copy; exp75 is not a one-line neighbour of a foreign notebook and mc25 did not model that case. (d) The morning files M1/M2 read at 18:30-19:18Z, after the 12:00Z card, so V_pub has to be re-checked at ~19:00Z (23:00 is the tick; the card only says 'by 12:00Z'). (e) exp75's 2,288 s dummy is in the rule-v2 re-run band (PC25-05), and exp75 is on the R21-A3(e) NO-GO list (PC25-02). The card mentions neither, and neither the exemption line nor the grandfather line is logged yet. The runtime itself is fine (exp79a sibling L 9.27-9.45 h < 10.75 h), and the 00:06Z night slot reads at ~09:30Z, in time.
fix: Rewrite card v3 as a NEUTRAL three-pair table with no default that relies on a JT claim. A = {V_pub, #37} (least public-tuned; hedges both levers). B = {V_pub, exp75} (hedges cap only; CI in both files). C = {V_pub, exp70g} (JT-literal: the closest-EV one-line neighbour; hedges CI only). Give mc25 ranges, and name the ONE deciding belief for each (B > A iff the user believes CI transfers, private mean >= +0.0001; C > B iff the user trusts cap 6's public +0.002 more than the in-sample lab). Replace 'ровно совет JT' with the quote and the note 'по критерию JT ближе exp70g (0.956)'. Delete the 'if JT, then exp75' clause at 0.954; at <= 0.954, exp75 drops out. Add branches: exp75 PENDING/not submitted at 12:00 UTC -> show A and C only, and re-check at 18:00 UTC. V_pub = E10 copy -> partner = the best of our own files (exp79a), since mc25 does not cover it. Re-check V_pub after the M1/M2 reads (~19:00 UTC). Write times as 'МСК (UTC)': 15:00 МСК (12:00 UTC), tick by 23:00 МСК (20:00 UTC), re-tick up to 02:59 МСК 30.09 (23:59 UTC). Log the exp75 rule-v2 exemption and the R21-A3(e) grandfather line in CONTEXT before the 00:06 UTC submit, and cite them on the card.
realistic_gain: Private: ~0 either way. B vs A is +0.01 expected bronze under the author's own prior and ~0 or negative at P(CI_priv<0) ~0.3; C vs B flips with the cap prior. The value of the fix is decision quality and honesty for the user's 29 Sep pick: no misattributed JT endorsement, times in MSK, and no gap if exp75 is late or V_pub changes. It is not a score gain.
